acquisition.required_boundary_policy: Conservative complete-topic acquisition before either conditional comparison: all required whole programs, derived certificates, mandatory data and retained finite records. No claim that this union is a minimal premise set for each application.

retained_scope.L050: All four corrected principal Theorem 1 clauses and 54 source dispositions. Named graph/classification/Brauer and historical code-table inputs remain retained. Uniqueness of all SRG(253,140,87,65) and the other two fifteen-dimensional L3(4) module constructions remain unresolved.
retained_scope.F017: All 104 recorded source dispositions, with seven explicitly retained input classes: association spectra, classical SRG parameters, earlier incidence-code descriptions, earlier distances, odd-characteristic incidence minima, ternary Proposition 18 memberships, and the prior generalized-Paley observation. Four large Paley pairs retain source upper bounds; general further-family and efficient-decoding questions are not solved.
retained_scope.corrections: The compared applications recover corrected contracts, not every erroneous literal assertion. The scientific source maps retain each correction and exclusion. This numerical comparison does not establish new results or accept unresolved source questions.
